caseNameFull: Devaney v. Cochran, Director, Division of Corrections of Florida and Byrd v. Warden, Maryland House of Correction
attorneys: Petitioners pro se., Richard W. Ervin, Attorney General of Florida, and B. Clarke Nichols, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent in No. 366, Mise.

opinions.text:
Motions for leave to file petitions for writs of habeas corpus denied. Treating the papers submitted as petitions for writs of certiorari, certiorari is denied.

Reported below: No. 831, Mise., 222 Md. 597, 158 A. 2d 120.
